Name: Garage Replacement for Tractor Mod (Barfy's Fancy Farmhouses style)
Author: Aralyssa
Description:
[size=3]This is a simple and cute garage replacement for use with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401?tab=posts]Tractor Mod[/url], designed to match the building replacements from [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/barfys-fancy-farmhouses-and-other-addons-update-links-are-back-up.112984/]Barfy's Fancy Farmhouses[/url]﻿. This is a mash-up of Barfy's stable & barn and the original Tractor Mod garage. I made this for personal use but decided I would share in case anybody else was interested.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/AYKAqv6.png[/img][/center]
[/size]
[b][u][size=3]Installation instructions:

[/size][/u][/b][size=3]1) Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401?tab=posts]Tractor Mod by Pathoschild[/url].
2) Download this file and extract using Winrar or a similar program.
3) Simply copy the garage.png file from this download and allow it to overwrite the garage.png file found in Stardew Valley\Mods\TractorMod\assets.

[/size]

Barfyscorpion and Pathoschild
